papers.headline: The Brown Dwarf Desert is a Mass-Ratio Desert: Astrometric Demographics of 63,254 Stars
papers.summary: Brown dwarfs are rare as close companions to stars compared to planets and stellar companions, a paucity known as the brown dwarf desert.
papers.title: The Brown Dwarf Desert is a Mass-Ratio Desert: Astrometric Demographics of 63,254 Stars

papers.headline: Little Red Dots from Primordial Black Holes: Non-Gaussianity and Accretion Evade μ-Distortion Constraints
papers.summary: Recent JWST observations of "Little Red Dots" (LRDs) at z ≳ 4 suggest the existence of early supermassive black holes (SMBHs) with masses ≳ 10⁶ M☉.
papers.title: Little Red Dots from Primordial Black Holes: Non-Gaussianity and Accretion Evade μ-Distortion Constraints

papers.headline: Search for a Dispersion Measure Excess Toward Nearby Galaxy Halos Using Fast Radio Bursts from the Second CHIME/FRB Baseband Catalog
papers.summary: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) probe foreground ionized baryons via their dispersion measures (DM).
papers.title: Search for a Dispersion Measure Excess Toward Nearby Galaxy Halos Using Fast Radio Bursts from the Second CHIME/FRB Baseband Catalog
